name: tuxracer-bunny-run
note: Bunny Hill from the race debug command; the paddle press at frame 10 skips the intro once both hosts are in it: paddle, turns, a jump and a braking turn; the Box3D slide must match on every host.

name: tuxracer-tree
note: A tree hit, felt in the pad and not in the camera: Bunny Hill, paddling and holding right until Tux runs into the trees at tick 569 (race.tree_hits). cam.offset holds the camera as drawn against the view on the frames within half a second of a tree hit or a touchdown: none off. cw.rumble is the engine's last request, the tree hit (heavy 0.9, light 0.5). Tux Racer never shook; this pins that it still does not. Control: holding left from frame 60 instead, no tree.
